sdk-assets:
| File | Kind | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| `surface.json` | `surface` | The stable surface: everything an API-only mod can name, each item with its fingerprint ([`surface.json`](02-surface.md)). |
| `build-data.tar.xz` | `build-data` | `internals.json`, `loops.json` and `functions.json`: data pinned to this build, with no compatibility promise. |
| `api-source.tar.xz` | `api-source` | The mod API's crates with their generated code written out: what a mod project's `.sunrise/sdk/api/` holds. |
| `runtime-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz`, `runtime-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu.tar.xz`, `runtime-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-server.tar.xz`, `runtime-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz` | `runtime` | The game's libraries, the prebuilt program the API route links mods into, its stub mods library and the package's identity file. |
| `api-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz`, `api-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu.tar.xz`, `api-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-server.tar.xz`, `api-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz` | `api` | Metadata of the mod API's crates and their procedural macros, build data and the mods library's template: what a mod on the mod API alone builds against. |
| `engine-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz`, `engine-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu.tar.xz`, `engine-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-server.tar.xz`, `engine-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz` | `engine` | Every other file of the prebuilt game: what a mod with a `[native.*]` table, game internals or a registry dependency builds against as well. |
| `tool-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz`, `tool-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu.tar.xz`, `tool-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz` | `tool` | `cargo-sunrise-mod` for that computer: `cargo sunrise-mod native-build` compiles native mods against this build as the launcher does ([`native-build`](08-native-build.md)). |
| `sdk.json` |  | The index: the build, every other asset with its SHA-256, size, kind and codec ([fields](01-release.md#sdkjson)). |
| `SHA256SUMS` |  | The SHA-256 of every file of the release. |
| `SHA256SUMS.sig` |  | Sunrise's signature over `SHA256SUMS` for the tag `sdk-<build id>`. |
sdk-hosts:
| Computer | Target | Game | Dedicated server |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linux, x86-64 | `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` | yes | yes |
| Windows, x86-64 | `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` | yes | no |
| macOS, Apple silicon | `aarch64-apple-darwin` | yes | no |
sdk-routes:
| Route | When | Slices it fetches |
|---|---|---|
| `api` | Every enabled mod uses the mod API alone. | `runtime`, `api` |
| `engine` | A mod has a `[native.*]` table, names game internals, or depends on a registry (crates.io) crate. | `runtime`, `api`, `engine` |
| `tool` | Before either: the native build tool, which tells the caller the route and then compiles. | `tool` |
